bullets.text: The Bears took over first place in the NFC North at 9-2, pushing the Lions down to second at 8-3.
The Ravens have lost six straight and sit 4-7, while the Bengals lead the AFC North at 7-3.
The Browns are 6-4 despite being outscored by 32 points, while the Texans are 4-6 with a +37 point differential.

teams.name: Bills
teams.story: The Bills are 9-1 and have won 6 straight, most recently beating MIA 26-9.

player.name: James Cook III
player.line: 89 yds and a TD vs MIA in Wk 11

teams.name: Patriots
teams.story: The Patriots have lost two straight, most recently 35-10 at DET, where QB Drake Maye was injured.

player.name: Drake Maye
player.line: Injured at DET; threw for 321 yds and 2 TD vs CHI

teams.name: Jets
teams.story: The Jets beat LAC 27-24 to snap a 5-game skid, but they are still 3-8.

player.name: Geno Smith
player.line: 17 of 21, 176 yds and 3 TD vs LAC

teams.name: Dolphins
teams.story: The Dolphins are 1-9 and have lost 4 straight, scoring a league-low 157 points.

player.name: Caleb Douglas
player.line: 3 catches, 71 yds vs IND in Wk 10

teams.name: Bengals
teams.story: The Bengals are 7-3 and lead the AFC North, but lost 22-20 at WSH on a last-second field goal.

player.name: Joe Burrow
player.line: 28/40, 300 yds and 2 TD in the Wk 11 loss at WSH

teams.name: Steelers
teams.story: The Steelers have lost two straight, 38-18 at CIN and 19-16 at PHI, and sit 6-4 in the AFC North.

player.name: Aaron Rodgers
player.line: 227 yds and a TD in the 19-16 loss at PHI

teams.name: Browns
teams.story: The Browns are 6-4 despite being outscored by 32 points, and they beat HOU 27-24 in Week 10.

player.name: Deshaun Watson
player.line: 312 yds and the winning drive vs HOU

teams.name: Ravens
teams.story: The Ravens have lost six straight, the latest 35-33 at CAR, and sit 4-7 in the AFC North.

player.name: Jacoby Brissett
player.line: 276 yds, 1 TD and 1 INT in the 35-33 loss at CAR

teams.name: Jaguars
teams.story: The Jaguars lead the AFC South at 7-3 but lost 23-18 at NYG, with Trevor Lawrence intercepted twice.

player.name: Parker Washington
player.line: 8 catches, 103 yds vs NYG

teams.name: Texans
teams.story: The Texans are 4-6 but have a +37 point differential after beating IND 26-3 on Thursday night.

player.name: C.J. Stroud
player.line: 3 TD vs IND, third straight game with 3+ TD passes

teams.name: Colts
teams.story: The Colts are 3-8 after losing 26-3 at HOU and have allowed a league-high 297 points.

player.name: Jonathan Taylor
player.line: 16 carries, 83 yds vs MIA in Wk 10

teams.name: Titans
teams.story: The Titans are 1-9 and have lost four straight, most recently 51-30 at DAL.

player.name: Tony Pollard
player.line: 21 carries, 110 yds at DAL

teams.name: Chiefs
teams.story: The Chiefs are 8-2 and atop the AFC West, with three straight wins, the latest a 34-7 win over ARI.

player.name: Patrick Mahomes
player.line: 27/39, 324 yds and 3 TD vs ARI

teams.name: Broncos
teams.story: The Broncos have won six straight and are 8-2, though their point differential is only +26.

player.name: Jonah Coleman
player.line: 111 yds and 3 TD vs LV last week

teams.name: Raiders
teams.story: The Raiders have lost three straight, the latest 38-24 at DEN, and have allowed a league-high 327 points.

player.name: Fernando Mendoza
player.line: 267 yds, 3 TD and an INT vs DEN

teams.name: Chargers
teams.story: The Chargers are 1-9 after losing 27-24 to NYJ, one game after beating BAL 23-20.

player.name: Omarion Hampton
player.line: 14 carries for 89 yds vs NYJ

teams.name: Giants
teams.story: The Giants are 6-3-1 and lead the NFC East on a +12 point differential, after beating JAX 23-18.

player.name: Malik Nabers
player.line: Caught a McCarthy TD pass in the 23-18 win over JAX

teams.name: Cowboys
teams.story: The Cowboys are 5-6 but lead the NFL with 337 points scored, after beating TEN 51-30.

player.name: Dak Prescott
player.line: 28/33, 325 yds and 4 TD vs TEN

teams.name: Commanders
teams.story: The Commanders are 4-5-1 and have won two straight, beating CIN 22-20 on a field goal as time expired.

player.name: Jayden Daniels
player.line: Led a 64-yard drive in 34 seconds to beat CIN

teams.name: Eagles
teams.story: The Eagles are 3-7 with a -70 point differential, but beat PIT 19-16 in Week 11.

player.name: Saquon Barkley
player.line: 17 carries, 75 yds and a TD vs PIT

teams.name: Bears
teams.story: The Bears beat DET 39-35 on a TD with 3 seconds left and are 9-2 on a six-game win streak.

player.name: Caleb Williams

teams.name: Lions
teams.story: The Lions lost 39-35 to CHI on a TD with 3 seconds left and are 8-3, 2nd in the NFC North.

player.name: Jahmyr Gibbs

teams.story: The Vikings have the NFL's fewest points allowed (161) but lost 35-10 at SF in their last game.

player.name: Justin Jefferson

player.name: Jordan Love

player.name: Chuba Hubbard

player.name: Bucky Irving
